notes.title: Vending Dokan Update #7: Welcome to Lunar Loop!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
First off, a huge thank you to all of you who’ve been playing, leaving kind reviews, and hanging out in the community. Seeing all of you in this space has been such a joy, we couldn’t ask for a better community!
[hr][/hr]A Brand New Location: Lunar Loop
This update might not be packed with quantity, but it definitely delivers on quality. We’re thrilled to introduce Lunar Loop, a brand-new train station location that brings something truly unique to Vending Dokan.


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/9721ff3f92827752a940c6556e1bb6c9014a6ef5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/3572ad7941a4d6776757ed80bc40e68585f0a9b2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/2c7afd6396aaa7274e3a061c2c927d7fb10a4cef.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/7336228b94fb4de86ad07b017d6c484ab03e7ea2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/7b218cdec1ebc7d7f62990d5129bb94885065b71.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/0af38c62bff66b834017c8a41e94a222c3966fb6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/7b52c374ca94b4dfb1e476a4e84c5f70669b7c3c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/4fc82f4ef597b616a28f054249d2f3b8d3f032a2.png"][/carousel]
Trains arrive and depart, bringing fresh waves of customers straight from the platform.

A large open sky above the station complete with moving clouds, gives this location a whole new vibe.

We’ve poured a ton of love into the ambience and soundscape, so it feels just right. The echo of trains, the distant chatter, and the station hum all help immerse you. Complete with a custom made jingle as the train departs!

The lighting has been reworked to capture that moody, cozy, late-night station feel.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/4fc82f4ef597b616a28f054249d2f3b8d3f032a2.png"]

This is one of the most atmospheric locations we’ve made yet, and we hope you’ll find it a perfect place to chill, manage your vending empire, and soak in the vibes.
[hr][/hr]Other Improvements & Fixes
While Lunar Loop is the star of this update, we’ve also made some smaller but meaningful improvements:

Brand Deals: now appear in a movable and resizable window, giving you more freedom to customize your HUD exactly how you want it.

Graphics Settings: you can now adjust anti-aliasing to better suit your system and visual preferances.

Bug Fix: raccoons will no longer randomly become kaiju-sized.

And as always, we’ve made more optimizations under the hood to keep things running smoother. This is an ongoing effort, so expect more improvements as we go.
[hr][/hr]What’s Next
Looking ahead, we’re cooking up a spooky October update just in time for Halloween! Expect limited-time items, seasonal decorations, and plenty of cozy-but-creepy vibes to set the mood right. 👻

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/800ac823c18e23b27d7d83d18092991861eec01f.png"]

We've also heard your request for more string lights, and seizing this as an opportunity to bring something unique and new to Vending Dokan, we've created a "draw string lights" system which allows you to connect your very own set of string lights on the ground or on the wall!

While this new system still needs more time to bake in the oven, we wanted to share a quick demo of how it works! This new system allows us to introduce a ton of new types of items into the game, from light bulbs to lanterns to hanging figures and decorations!
[previewyoutube="tp0rBU244qE;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]
Thanks again for being part of this journey, your feedback and support mean the world. We can’t wait to hear what you think of Lunar Loop!

See you on the platform,
💜 The Vending Dokan Team

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/05a5f5cdb87ea8b77a50647f5480af0c402d507b.png"]

notes.title: Vending Dokan Update #6: Pluto Pass, New Machines & Fresh Decorations!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
As always, thank you for playing, for your feedback, and for being part of the Vending Dokan community. Today’s update brings a brand-new location, along with new machines, decorations, and more to make your alleys prettier, cozier, and more functional.
[hr][/hr]🌳 New Location: Pluto Pass
Pluto Pass is here!
This quaint little alleyway is tucked away from cars and surrounded by trees and greenery, a quieter corner of the city.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/34ef8d8a888c67f154c7e0eacf65a34f1829d653.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/12032ced0d20dbab972fa8c9a0d96e4e3d6636ec.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/dffdeb1196e474d602b3629199649932f8ab566c.png"][/carousel]
Build on both sides of the road and on the road itself

Customers will explore both surfaces, giving you more creative freedom

Unlocks at Milestone 17 for $35,000

We can’t wait to see how you decorate and operate this gorgeous new spot!

With this new location, we've also decided to give you a bit more freedom to place machines slightly inside the walls, creating an "integrated" look. We'll be doing this as a test run with this location, but please let us know what you think of this behaviour, does it allow for more creativitiy or does it just look like it's a bug? You let us know! 
[hr][/hr]🥤 3 New Vending Machines
We’re expanding your vending options with three new machines, each with its own style and purpose:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/36f514ae23ac2a954d264567d0e4dee5d1f82f6d.png"]MoonSip Nova
A compact 4-slot machine with a nostalgic, retro design. Cute and cozy, it balances smaller capacity with an aesthetic that draws in the elderly and night owls. (Unlocks at Milestone 4)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/985ea706a97273cc39c4a32a39fac8428e026873.png"]SnackShack Tower
A tall 3-slot vertical machine with a diner-inspired look. Its layout provides a neat balance of variety and capacity. (Unlocks at Milestone 8)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/df91fe68b27fcec3e585b150ef483998f645cc74.png"]Snackscape Panorama
A wide 7-slot machine built for maximum variety. Though each slot has limited capacity, its selection makes it a favorite for curious customers seeking choice. (Unlocks at Milestone 10)
[hr][/hr]🦝 Meet the Raccoons!
Our beloved cats now have a rival: raccoons!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/fe0a7e28480667850ca8e3ac9d24930234a6e210.png"]These critters are still in an early stage of development, but you’ll start to see them wandering the world. For now, they behave similarly to cats, but expect them to become more unique as Early Access progresses.
[hr][/hr]💡 New Decoration Type: Volumes
Originally, we had string lights planned for this month. Instead, we’re introducing something new: Floating Light Volumes!


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/98b47e6f1b1258c7e23455dbb01a313deefe250e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/12032ced0d20dbab972fa8c9a0d96e4e3d6636ec.png"][/carousel]
Place them like any other decoration in Build Mode

They can be stacked on top of other items (as long as they’re inside your location’s boundaries)

Each volume continuously spawns a decorative item (like floating lanterns ✨)

To make decorating easier, you can toggle to hide volumes in Build Mode, so they don’t cover up chairs or tables when placed nearby.
[hr][/hr]🪧 Custom Signs
Introducing custom signs!
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/fdff85255c0131a3634769fe070c058a173885b7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/fecee61826f8f54ef07fb78e0cf77861dc16384d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/d242ff8de275c9174218555ee4dfefe4df6c3d51.png"][/carousel]

This first version includes one model in three sizes. Place a sign, then right-click it to add your own message. Your text will scroll across the sign in a marquee fashion. More customization options are planned for the future!
[hr][/hr]🌿 Trellises & Design Potential
We’ve added trellis frames and matching plants to open up tons of design possibilities.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/f262e8c3a4648453e93677b3b772e683e1d0fded.png"]

Place wooden trellises on walls (two sizes available)

Mix and match with trellis plants

Disable collision checks in Build Mode to get creative, layer smaller pieces on top, or combine them with other items like the new neon sign pack for unique looks!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/528b78d641c0ee3ab5f7f22aaabfcea9b03cbe92.png"]

The possibilities are wide open, and we can’t wait to see what you come up with!
[hr][/hr]🗑️ New Bins
We heard you: the old blue bin was getting boring.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/80de0ad89f10582131c6dc42ae2c7a3037837a9a.png"]This update introduces a range of new bins with different looks! They behave exactly the same as before, so you can drop them into your setups without learning anything new.
[hr][/hr]
That’s everything for today’s update! We’ve got another update coming later this month, featuring another new location. Let’s just say, you’ll want to mind the gap when expanding your vending empire! 🚉

If you're enjoying the game, you can help us out by leaving a Steam review! it seriously helps us reach more people and continue to grow.

Thanks for reading, and we’ll see you in the next update!

💛 The Vending Dokan Team

notes.title: Productivity Tools, Real-Time Clock, & More in Vending Dokan's #5 Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Thank you so much for continuing to play, support, and share your feedback on Vending Dokan.
We’ve been closely watching how people play the game and what features they’re asking for, and today’s update is all about making Vending Dokan an even better companion while you work, study, or relax.


[hr][/hr]🧠Productivity Tools
This update introduces the a suit of productivity tools, designed to help you stay focused, organized, and mindful, all while running your vending empire in the background.

You’ll find these tools in the top panel, separated by a line for clarity.
Focus Timer
Our version of the Pomodoro Technique, this tool helps you break your work into focused intervals (default 30 mins), followed by short breaks.
You can name your task, set session length, break time, and number of rounds, perfect for maintaining productivity while the game runs passively.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/92214aa959befc1dffe8d736e89cb1385ffd728b.png"]
To-Do List
A simple in-game checklist to track your real-life tasks. Whether you’re studying, cleaning, or working on creative projects, this makes Vending Dokan the perfect cozy background companion.
Journal
Write down thoughts, reflections, or goals. It’s your own in-game notebook, perfect for mindfulness, motivation, or just venting about customers littering.

These features are just the beginning, and we have plans to expand & polish them further in future updates.


🖱️ UI Ovehaul: Move More Widgets & Resize Them!
We’ve overhauled how on-screen widgets behave. You can now:

Drag more of them, like the clock, to wherever you like

Resize them to fit your layout

Right-click to reset their position (no more cluttering the UI with reset buttons)

Customize your layout exactly how you want it, whether you’re deep in management mode or keeping it chill on the side. We will continue to improve UI scaling and customizability over time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/d9cf95ca1a35fa269a2e9703ac2e0762edb09ac6.png"]


🕓 Toggle Between In-Game & Real-World Time
You can now click the in-game clock to switch its display to your real-life system time, no matter what speed the game is running at: real-time, 1x, 2x, etc.
A simple way to keep an eye on the real world while staying immersed in the game.


🐱 You Can Now Feed Cats!
That’s right. You can feed the cats.

Place the new Cat Bowl from the build menu, fill it with kibble, and nearby cats will come by for a snack.
Each time they eat, your friendship with that cat increases, so keep those kitties fed!
[hr][/hr]

🧃 4 New Pouch Drinks from Midnight Drinks!
Midnight Drinks is back with a refreshing new lineup in a brand-new category: Pouch Drinks!

 Peach Juice

 Grape Juice

 Limeaid

 Caramel Latte

These new drinks unlock at Milestone 14, come with strong profit margins, and are sure to keep your machines stocked with flavor.


💸 Economy Balancing
We’ve made some changes to prevent milestone rewards from breaking progression:

On Default and higher economy difficulties, you’ll now only receive money rewards for Milestones 1–5

The Reward Machine’s money conversion has also been toned down to make sales and smart management more valuable

These changes aim to create a more rewarding long-term experience, especially for players looking for a bit more challenge and strategy.


🗺️ Roadmap Update
We took a little extra time to flesh out the Productivity Tools and get them to a good starting point. As a result, we’ve shifted some things around in our roadmap to better reflect our updated development schedule and your feedback.

You can always view the updated roadmap in-game, or check it out below:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/1619818ad5b50318fa9c1558345386643e9f97e4.png"]
[hr][/hr]


That’s it for now, but we’ve got another update coming later this month, including a brand-new location to explore!

If you're enjoying the game, you can help us out by leaving a Steam review! It seriously helps us reach more people and continue to grow.



Thanks so much for reading, and we’ll see you in the next update! 💛

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/05a5f5cdb87ea8b77a50647f5480af0c402d507b.png"]

notes.title: Machine Fixing, Staff Breaks & More in Vending Dokan's First Major Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
This is a pretty major update, packed with new gameplay, new items, and lots of improvements, all inspired by your feedback.
We’ve been closely monitoring your suggestions and bug reports, and we’re thrilled to bring many of them into the game today. Let’s dive in!


[previewyoutube="R0M5iK6xq8c;full"][/previewyoutube]

🔨 New Gameplay: Machine Fixing
From now on, machines can not only get dirty… they can also break!

But don’t worry, you’re now armed with a trusty hammer!
Every machine has parts that can break, more complex machines have more parts, and you can fix them in the new Fixing Tab in the inspection menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/3f2e8ab1234b3734f966cec6023d2db8d63ff6ad.gif"]

Here’s how it works:

Open the inspection menu and switch to the Fixing Tab

Hover over highlighted parts of the machine and hold left click to hammer away

Each strike of the hammer has a chance to improve the part’s health

Hit the little hammer icon that appears randomly for a bonus!

We know fixing could become tedious, so…


🧰 Tool Upgrades!
You can now upgrade both your hammer and sponge using Vend Points, directly from the same menu. Stronger tools mean faster, more satisfying maintenance, let us know what you think!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/d1e21f4296308177200847b82283d6b8d43ce50e.gif"]

And if you’d rather delegate, you can now assign your staff to the new Mechanic role.
Mechanics will automatically fix machines when their health drops below 50%.

💡 Tip: higher technical skill = faster, more reliable repairs!

To make finding broken machines easier, we’ve also added:

A danger icon

A smoke effect on broken parts

And note: Customers won’t use broken machines!

Also, breaking is less frequent in Idle Mode, so you can keep the game running in the background stress-free.


🪑 Staff Breaks & Office Expansion
Your staff now need to take breaks, and you can now expand your office space to accommodate them!

Expand your office using the Expand button in Build Mode.

During their two-hour mid-shift break, staff will visit the office to rest.

Place hangout spots, chairs, sofas, benches, and even vending machines so they can recover both energy and hunger.

Happier staff perform better, show up more reliably, and level up faster!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/b8b5d48d92506ca739533ea56d989e38de9f58e5.gif"]

You can monitor their mood and stats either by hovering over them for a quick look or by checking the staff menu for a detailed view.


🌸 New Decorations
To help you create the perfect office (and locations), we’ve added tons of new decorations: including awnings, flower pots, lights, and more.
Find them in the Build Menu, no unlocking through the reward machine required!


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/388af338891207101c90dc2084c960dda00c3b3a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/7923334f8dacee5ffa5764d47838e8f22b707d15.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/07eb65b1d9b2bcd2efdeaf2df2a6a252c6bf1e61.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/160b1dddb820c4e29a3e29457d579957d92aea8d.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/d2aefb49cd19768fbac48bcae0ee761875cd5dce.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/bf09a6b7c555206101747bc349af539b5b0ff22f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/bbe910d4c0484b43c9da5b0015a00a97615c66f8.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/f043537663f81c39ab298b43ddbf106182f7d969.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/ff8d2937eb60f19dee64bb67da89e408ca22c659.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/024d3ec2e866583c1c0a0d92fc0fd97524d57bc5.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/2585a2b1db1a7200b1d67b43e1c3513a9ae2f8d2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/5c28e14e8e343098a5fdc148833987ad45e9aa70.jpg"][/carousel]

🎁 Reward Machine Changes
Fixed a rare soft lock bug when using the Reward Machine

Money rewards are now much rarer

Decorative item rewards are now much more common

🎶 4 New Songs!
Our composer, Jellyfox, has crafted four new tracks to chill to while playing.
All are available immediately, enjoy these new earworms and let us know what you think!


🇫🇷 French Language Support
We’re excited to welcome French as the first localized language in Vending Dokan!
The settings menu has been updated to support this, and we’ve even added a few in-game items to celebrate.

Nous espérons que vous apprécierez encore plus le jeu maintenant!

This is just the beginning and more languages are on the way!


💰 Economy Difficulty
Find the game too easy? Too hard?
You can now adjust the economy difficulty in the Settings Menu to tailor the experience to your liking.


🧹 Smaller QoL Changes & Fixes
Build item descriptions no longer clip through the bottom of the screen

You can now access settings from both the main menu and pause menu

Staff should no longer get stuck in doorways

Updated the Twitch API permissions to remove unnecessary scopes

Added the option to disable collision checks when decorating, so you can clip items into each other for more creative freedom

Improved profit UI: profit is now the main number displayed when assigning or buying items for machines, with buy and sell prices alongside it
📝 Roadmap Update
We’ve shuffled a few things in the roadmap, and wanted to keep you all informed:

Lockers while available are decorative for now, their full functionality is coming in a future update, once we gather more data on staff morale.

Assigning staff to locations and machines has also been moved to a future update so we can test staff changes incrementally.



Thank you all for playing, sharing your feedback, and helping us make Vending Dokan even better.

We have another update coming later this month, and plenty more planned beyond that, so stay tuned!

If you’re enjoying the game, you can help us out by leaving a Steam review, it really helps us reach more players and continue to grow.



Thank you for reading, and we’ll see you in the next update!

💛 Aftabi Games Team

notes.title: Vending Dokan: Update #3 + Roadmap Reveal!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We just want to start this post by saying thank you. Seriously, you all have been amazing!

From sharing your creations on the Workshop, to posting your thoughts on the forums and Discord, and especially to those of you reporting bugs and offering suggestions: we see you, and we appreciate you. Thanks to your feedback, this is now the third regular update we've shipped, and several of your suggestions have been directly implemented into the game as a result. ❤️


📌 The Big One: Our Roadmap is Here!
We're incredibly excited to share the first iteration of the Vending Dokan Roadmap!

We took our time with this because we wanted to absorb your feedback over the first few weeks of Early Access, now that we’ve had the chance to evaluate and prioritize everything, we’re ready to show you what’s next.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/c7f29faa0d2508c4b2419f83e023e8bec86876db.png"]

🗓️ This roadmap spans the first 6 months of development, with a major focus on July.
We’ll be updating it as we go, and expanding on details as features roll out.

🖼️ You can also view the roadmap in-game. Just head to your office and check it out! If you’re ever wondering what’s coming next, you’ll find it there.


📦 Staff Restocking Role (First Iteration)
Say hello to the new Staff Role: Restocking!

This is the first version of this role, and here’s what your staff can do with it:

Bin empty boxes lying around your office or in shelves

Restock vending machines when any slot falls below 50% & you have the stock for it

✅ Pro tip: Make sure you have at least one bin in your office, or the staff won’t be able to do much! They can pick up boxes from both the floor and shelves, as long as they can navigate to it.

In future updates, we’ll be expanding this role with the ability to:

Move boxes from floor to shelves

Combine boxes

Reorganize your office based on your assignment of what should go where

We’d love to hear your thoughts on this new role, drop your feedback on the Steam forums or Discord!


🎁 17 New Reward Machine Items!
We’ve added 17 new items to the Reward Machine, including:

🟣 11 new rare stickers

🪴 6 new decorative items

Hope you enjoy unlocking and customizing with these new goodies!


🛠️ Rest of the Patch Notes
Some nice little quality-of-life updates and fixes:

WASD movement is now available in Build Mode and Freecam

Hotkeys added:

O for Office

Arrow Keys to switch location

C to toggle between cameras

F for Freecam

B for Build Mode

U for Business Menu
(We're working on a rebind system so you can customize these soon!)

Machine hover prompts now update in real time

Machines no longer become un-interactable after staff interact with them

Stone Lantern 01 now spawns correctly

Deleting gnomes now gives back the correct gnome

Delivery zones now have consistent capacity regardless of their orientation

Reward Machine now takes 1 hour of real time to fully charge

Binning boxes now generates significantly less rubbish


We'll have our next big update coming in early July, which will include even more decorations and most importantly: a bigger overhaul to the staff system. We're really excited about what's coming next and can't wait to share more with you soon.

In the meantime, we'd love to hear what you think!

📣 Let us know in the comments below, or join the conversation on our Discord.

🐛 Got a bug to report? We've got dedicated Steam Forums for that too!

If you're enjoying the game, you can help us out by leaving a Steam review! It seriously helps us reach more people and continue to grow.



Thanks so much for reading, and see you next time! 💛

notes.title: Galaxy Rise is now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just wanted to say a massive thank you for the incredible first week since launch. It's been amazing to see so many of you playing the game, sharing your creations on the Workshop, chatting in the forums, and giving us thoughtful feedback.

Your bug reports and suggestions have been invaluable, many of the changes in this update come directly from things you’ve pointed out. We’re committed to continuing to improve the game with your help, and today’s update is just the start.


New Location: Galaxy Rise
We’ve added a brand new location called Galaxy Rise, a bustling shopping district that stands out from other areas in both design and vibe. It’s a bit more unique and visually striking, and we think you’ll really enjoy setting up shop there.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/9585796313a9512f4ed57a0b34caf730957f4f3d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/45884267eff130de056627fcfe0beed7d814ca47.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/9a7847102a5f1ffac1b8ec332e4c79dfac78fabc.png"][/carousel]

🛠️ Available for all existing and new saves, no need to start over!

More locations are in the works, so keep an eye out as we continue to expand the game’s world.


10 New Reward Machine Items
We’ve added 10 new decorative items to the reward machine! These include:

New lamps and lighting

Cat statues

Toad statues
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/b9d43e916565702fff066c0585326b2164da9f8e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/1d63f8a8524fd0e5665f21b9728d64e243c7d12b.png"][/carousel]Bug fixes & QOL Changes
Here’s the full list of fixes and tweaks in today’s update:

Boxes placed on top of one another on shelves should no longer clip into each other when loading a game.

Improved chair collision, NPCs should no longer get stuck on them.

Navigation improvements across the map:

Fixed a broken nav path at Meteor Lane.

Fixed a shopping centre nav issue that caused NPCs (staff and customers) to occasionally fall off the map.

Fixed a vend point exploit where selling vend point items returned more than they cost.

Fixed inconsistencies with deliveries where you could receive more or less than what you ordered.

Adjusted janitor staff task priorities from:
Clean Machine > Empty Bin > Clear Rubbish
to:
Clear Rubbish > Empty Bin > Clean Machine
This makes them perform much more reliably.

NPCs should no longer get stuck on benches.

Delivery boxes now change brightness based on how full they are: brighter when full, darker when empty.

Delivery box collision has been optimized.

Brand new transition screen when switching between locations!

Changed zoom behaviour in Build Mode and Freecam, it now physically moves the camera forward instead of changing the FOV.

Reordered the location list, they now appear in order of price.

Freecam is now available in all locations!

When hovering over a populated item slot in a vending machine, you can now instantly see the demographic chart. No need to dig through your inventory anymore.


What’s Next?
We’re working on a bigger feature update for next week, which will include:

More decorations

A major staff system overhaul, including the addition of a new staff role.
Join the Discussion
Want to share your thoughts on this update? Let us know in the comments!

Got a bug to report? You can do so in our Bug Reports Steam Subforum.

👉 Join our Discord to hang out with the community and chat directly with us.



And if you’re enjoying the game so far, leaving a Steam review really helps us out. It’s one of the best ways to support the game and get more eyes on it. 🥰



Thanks for reading, and we'll see you in next week's update![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/05a5f5cdb87ea8b77a50647f5480af0c402d507b.png"]

notes.title: First Post-Launch Patch! A Thank You + QOL Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
First off, thank you so much for playing Vending Dokan! Seeing so many of you dive into the game after the Wholesome Direct has been amazing, and we're so grateful to be a part of such a kind and supportive community.

A special shoutout to everyone who’s already been experimenting with the Machine Designer! Some of the custom skins you've made are incredible. We absolutely can’t wait to build on this system and bring even more creative tools your way!


🛠️ Quality of Life Hotfix
We’ve pushed a small patch today that focuses on smoothing out a few pain points and addressing some community feedback. Here's what's new:

“Hold to Continue” Threshold Lowered
These now confirm at 90% instead of 97.5%, making them a little easier to use.

Hold Button Redundancy Fix
We’ve added some redundancy to holding logic in an attempt to fix a rare bug where “click and hold” buttons don’t progress. We still haven’t been able to reproduce it ourselves, but hopefully this solves it!
👉 If you ran into this issue, please let us know in this thread.

Milestone Popups Now Show Location Unlocks
Helpful clarity for when you unlock new areas!

Milestone History Added
One of the most requested features, thank you for the suggestion! You can now view a timeline of everything you've unlocked as well as what’s coming up.
Find it under the Business Menu in a brand-new tab.

Persistent Tick Sound Bug Fixed
Reaching a milestone while cleaning a bin no longer causes the tick sound to loop forever.

ESC Closes Business Menu
You can now use the Escape key to close the business menu, in addition to the button on the UI.

Idle Mode Adjustments
Machines now get dirty much more slowly and NPCs litter less while the game is running in Idle Mode. Idle mode activates when you click out of the game or your cursor hasn't moved for 2 minutes. This should make playing passively feel less overwhelming.
👉 We’re still thinking about more QOL tweaks for Idle Mode. let us know what you’d like to see in this thread.

Expanded Volume Controls
You can now adjust master volume, dialogue, and other audio settings from both the pause menu and the music drawer.

Real-Time Button is Now a Toggle
Clicking it while in Real-Time Mode will now return the game to normal x1 speed.

🎨 Layer Re-Ordering in the Designer!
Another big one! You can now re-order layers in the Machine Designer, giving you even more flexibility when customizing your machines. Keep those amazing designs coming!
[hr][/hr]
Thank you all again for checking out this update and for being part of our little vending world. We're just getting started, and your support means everything as we continue to improve and expand the game.

If you’re enjoying Vending Dokan, please consider leaving us a Steam review! It seriously helps more than you know and supports the continued growth of our game. 💙

(Version number at the bottom right of your screen should say 0.12.17)

Much love,
– The Vending Dokan Team

notes.title: Vending Dokan: Kozy Kiosk is Out Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’re incredibly excited to welcome you to the world of Vending Dokan: Kozy Kiosk, now available in Early Access!

After being featured in Wholesome Direct (thank you all so much for the love!), we’re thrilled to open our vending empire up to you all everywhere. This is just the beginning, and whether you want to micromanage every box or relax in passive mode while working on something else, we hope you find something to love here.


💡 What’s New in the Launch Update?
Alongside our Early Access release, we’ve also been hard at work responding to your feedback from the demo and our amazing Patreon supporters. Here’s what’s new:


🏆 Reworked Milestones
Milestones have been redesigned to feel more rewarding and better paced. You’ll now unlock more content as you grow, including an entirely new brand of items: McLaffy’s Delites!
🧠 NPC AI & Performance Improvements
We’ve rebuilt how NPCs work behind the scenes. They’re no longer affected by framerate, and their environmental awareness is much sharper. With this update, NPCs can now sit down to enjoy purchases, creating a much more "alive" feel for this window into another world.
🏢 Freecam in the Office
You can now enable freecam (previously only available in Build Mode) in the Office, making inventory management and box moving much smoother. We're currently rolling this out only to the office, but we'll be looking into potentially adding it to all locations.
🎙 Reworked Tutorials + Candoo Voiceover
Tutorials have been rewritten and restructured for clarity and pacing. And yes: Candoo now has a voice! Voiced by the talented Matt Gardner, our excitable vending guide now feels more alive than ever.


📝 Rest of the Changelog
Adjusted graphics presets for better visuals and performance across quality levels

New pause menu: cleaner layout, social links, and return-to-main-menu button

Build items no longer reset their rotation when picked up

Increased custom design layer limit from 20 to 30! Go crazy with the designs!

You can now fire staff. we'll be expanding on the staff system in future updates but we thought it was neccessary to at least allow for firing for now.

NPCs should no longer keep playing the purchasing animation when walking away

NPCs now have proper consumption animations for snacks

NPC litter should rarely fall through the map now

Staff now consistently empty bins and do so when fill level >50%

Fixed a location rating visual bug that always showed 5 stars

Full Delivery UI implemented: You can now track your deliveries in detail, see how many boxes will arrive and what has been ordered!

New feature: Unlock item stickers when you unlock stock items, usable in the Machine Designer!

Removing an item from a vending machine no longer just refund you the money and instead returns it to your office in an existing box. If no box is found the game will try to add new ones in the delivery zone.

Vending machine inventory menu now shows all unlocked items, with a filter to only show in-stock items

Deleting a vending machine now returns its contents to your inventory

Vending machines no longer inherit custom designs from other machines by mistake


🔮 On the Horizon
We’ll be sharing a public roadmap soon so you can follow our plans throughout Early Access. You can expect regular updates, quality-of-life improvements, and new features based on your feedback!

We’ll also be running community surveys to help shape the future of the game, and we’d love to hear from you. Join the discussion and share your alleyways, strategies, or just come say hi!

Join our official Discord here



From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for your support. Whether you played the demo, backed us on Patreon, or are just discovering Vending Dokan today. We can’t wait to see what you build 💛

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/05a5f5cdb87ea8b77a50647f5480af0c402d507b.png"]

notes.title: Machine Designer & More in Vending Dokan's First Major Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, pouring every ounce of energy into making Vending Dokan better, smoother, and more full of life. Now we’re finally ready to show you what we’ve been working on, and trust us, it was worth the wait. Let’s get into it 👇

🎨 Machine Designer

Yes, you read that right.
The full vending machine designer is now live!

This is something we’ve wanted to do since day one. Create a deep, expressive designer that lets you make machines the way racing games let you customise cars. And now, it’s here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/1fdad694b171bef714aa5e94859686ef8641c83b.png
You can find the Designer in the Customization tab of every machine. You’ll be able to change colors, apply patterns, add decals, and more.

Even better: Steam Workshop is fully supported in the non-demo version. You can upload your own creations or browse other players’ machines via the right-hand panel. Unforutnetly due to how steam workshop works with demos, we aren't able to allow you to upload or download creations from the workshop in the demo version of the game.

Looking ahead, we’ll be adding:

 Unlockable stickers via milestones and the Reward Machine
 Brand-specific stickers that affect how customers perceive your business
 Fancy finishes like foil and galaxy colors (✨👀)

We can’t wait to see what you create.

🌃 Sneak Peek: Galaxy Rise

You’ll now be able to preview a brand-new location: Galaxy Rise, nestled in the heart of the city’s shopping district.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/5655bf0a8650f191480b8d3511feb99a851ab25c.png
While it’s not playable just yet, this preview gives a first look at how diverse the vibes and aesthetics of our locations will be across the full game. From quiet alleyways to bustling malls, each spot will have its own personality and Galaxy Rise is bursting with colour, signage, and a fast-paced, big-city energy.

Stay tuned, this is just one of several new areas we’re cooking up.

🎁 Reward Machine!

One of the biggest new features: the Reward Machine is here, and it’s for you.

This is a fully buildable machine that charges in real time. That means speeding the game up won’t affect it. It’s designed to slot gently into your real-life routine. The longer you leave it charging, the rarer and more valuable the rewards become. There are 5 lights on top to show its charge level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478888/4eb09fdbd78fb50e45dc0677a573808692536961.png
The idea is simple: just play, and get rewarded.

You’ll be able to earn in-game money, exclusive decorations, and even new music tracks, all only available through this system. We think it’s going to become a fan favorite.

The reward machine is currently unavailable in the demo as we continue to playtest with our patreon community :)

🎵 Other Additions & Improvements


 New music! Our composer Jellyfox has been crafting more lo-fi bops to keep you company while you manage your vending empire.
 Better tooltips and tutorials. We saw some of you didn’t realise the game could be sped up, now that’s much clearer. Customer groups are also easier to identify at a glance.
 More customer variety! You’ll see more diversity in customer appearances, while keeping each group easily recognisable.
 Improved build menu. Items are now organized into categories with visual cues for what’s available to purchase.
 New secondary currency: Vend Points. Earned through purchases made at your machines. Some items, like the Reward Machine, will require these.
 Box buying & basket tweaks. You can now buy items by the box, and use your mouse wheel while hovering over the "Add" button to quickly stack up.
 Atmosphere updates. We reworked ambient and environmental sounds to make your spaces feel even cozier and more alive.


We’ll be watching your feedback closely and will be running another survey very soon, so let us know what you think, what you love, and what you want more of!

And we’re not done yet, there’s so much more exciting news coming soon. Make sure to keep an eye out so you don’t miss it.

🎥 Are you a content creator?

We’ve just launched our Aftabi Games influencer sign-up form!

If you're a YouTuber, streamer, TikToker, or just love sharing games with your audience, you can sign up here and we’ll be in touch.

Thank you so much for reading, and for your continued support!

– The Aftabi Games team 💛

notes.title: Vending Dokan is in Next Fest! Play the Demo Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re thrilled to share that Vending Dokan is officially part of Steam Next Fest! 🎉 That means you can play the demo right now and get a taste of cozy vending machine management. The game is still in its early stages, and we want to involve you as early as possible, so your feedback is incredibly valuable.

💡 Big change! The demo no longer has a milestone limit! You can keep playing past Milestone 5 for as long as you’d like! You won’t unlock additional milestones beyond that, but feel free to keep growing your vending empire.

🔧 New Update: Features, Optimizations & Streamer Tools
We pushed an update last night packed with new features, optimizations, and bug fixes. One of the biggest additions is Streamer Tools! If you stream the game on Twitch, you can now:

 ✨ Earn in-game money for followers, subs, and cheers
 ✨ Have your viewers show up as customers in the world
 ✨ See the chat in-game

Perfect for chill, interactive streams! If you stream, we’ve got a "now-streaming-vending-dokan" channel on our official discord where you can share your link. We also have spaces to show off your alleyways and decorations, open to everyone! 

You are also welcomed to share your thoughts over on our Steam Forums for Vending Dokan! We'll be looking forward to hear what you think!

🗣 Spread the Word!
If you enjoy Vending Dokan, please share it with your friends & family and help us spread the word! Since we’re currently planning to self-publish, every bit of support means the world to us.

Thank you for being on this journey with us! We hope you enjoy the demo, and we can’t wait to hear what you think. 💖
